AN ORDINANCE PROVIDING FOR COUNTY BUILDING PERMITS PURSUANT TO THE CONSTITUTION AND LAWS OF THE STATE OF GEORGIA PROVIDING FROM HOME RULE TO PROVIDE FOR BUILDING PERMITS FOR ALL NEW CONSTRUCTION WITHIN THE COUNTY LIMITS; TO PROVIDE FOR IT AND EFFECTIVE DATE; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS OF TREUTLEN COUNTY, GEORGIA, AND IT IS HEREBY ORDAINED BY THE AUTHORITY OF THE STATE OF GEORGIA AS GRANTED UNDER HOME RULE STATUE AS FOLLOWS:
1: business building or other structure shall be commenced and no pre-existing structure may be occupied without first obtaining a county building permit. Application for said permits shall be made at the Treutlen County Tax Assessor’s office at the Treutlen County Courthouse Annex in Soperton, Georgia. There will be no charge for any such building permit provided the provisions of this ordinance are complied with as set out hereafter.
